name: slack-thread-to-notion-discussion
disabled_note: Disabled 2026-10-31 by Dennis, with its two companions: the full two-way comment sync wasn't worth its cost once Next Gen Zap billing starts (2026-12-01; ~1,100 runs a month each for the two event Zaps, nearly all skips). Revival approved 2026-11-12: Zapier dropped the planned 1-task floor (per a Zapier PM in the NoCodeOps Discord), so a run that exits without an app action is free, and these skips exit at code and Table reads. Re-enable all three after the revival PR merges.

deploy.description: Slack -> Notion half of the thread <-> discussion two-way sync. Listens to every public-channel message (instant Slack event subscription; fires on thread replies too — verified by deployed test 2026-09-01). A message in a mapped thread mirrors into the mapped Notion discussion as a comment under the Slack author's own display_name. A message in an unmapped thread that names a ticket (TKT-###) or pastes a Notion page URL asks for approval in-thread (Slack Request Approval, Approve and Reject buttons, anyone may click; Reject marks the thread declined so it never prompts again; expires after 30 days) and on approval links the thread: opens a page-level discussion (joins the newest open page-level thread if the page already has one — API limitation), backfills the thread, and confirms in-thread. Everything else exits at the free guard path.
deploy.note: Never attempted by failed publish run 33483876845 (2026-09-01) — the job died on the sweep before reaching this directory. Touched so the retry merge picks it up.

trigger.trigger_note: Public channels only by design (v1 scope). listen_for_bots is set to no but has proven inconsistent — the workflow body re-checks user.is_bot explicitly, which is also echo-suppression layer 1 for the sync's own Slack posts.
trigger.why_not_polling: Deployed Slack triggers register a Slack event subscription (delivery in seconds). Sample polls never show thread replies — that is documented test-time behaviour, not the deployed behaviour.

description: Slack -> Notion half of the Slack thread <-> Notion discussion two-way sync (TKT-825). Mention a TKT-### (or paste a Notion page URL) in any public Slack thread, then approve the in-thread prompt to link it to that task; from then on every human message in the thread mirrors into the task's Notion discussion, attributed via display_name. Companion Zaps: notion-comment-to-slack-thread (reverse direction) and slack-notion-thread-sync-sweep (resolve detection + self-healing backstop).
